events.journal_text: A letter has arrived at your lodgings.
events.hud_message: A letter waits at your lodgings.

events.journal_text: Mrs. Pemberton has become notably more guarded. Time may be running out.
You return to the study to find the desk has been cleared — someone has removed the remaining evidence.
events.hud_message: Something has changed in the study.

events.journal_text: The witness you needed to interview has left town. A chance missed.
events.hud_message: Someone important has left. You may have waited too long.
